CHANGSHA, Nov. 15 , 2006 (Xinhua)

Starting line-up of China against Iraq at Asian Cup qualifiers




Following is the line-up of China national football team against Iraq at an Asian Cup qualifier here on Wednesday:

Goalkeeper: Li Leilei

Defenders: Sun Xiang, Xu Yunlong, Zhang Yaokun, Cao Yang

Midfielders: Zheng Zhi, Wang Dong, Du Zhenyu, Zhao Junzhe

Forwards: Li Jinyu, Han Peng
